title: KAITO — Secret Guidance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Two months before the School Festival
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Good job, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And good job today, Len, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks! But I feel like I could've kept going.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too!
It's so fun to rehearse with you♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, Tsukasa.
When will I see you next?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I'm not sure any of us will be able to drop in for a while.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be busy preparing for our School Festival.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A School Festival? Is that when students run pop-up food stalls and organize various events?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's exactly right! In case you were wondering, my class is doing a theatrical performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe! Even for the festival,
Tsukasa's gonna be on stage♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's good for you, Tsukasa.
What's your play about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that's a secret! But I can tell you that it's going to be a masterpiece because I wrote the script AND am the lead actor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm surprised your classmates were okay with that. A play's a lot of work, so most people try to avoid doing one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. They tried to shoot me down at first, but when I showed them the script, they unanimously approved it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Somehow, I find that hard to believe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it is the truth! This play is so exquisite, it moves people to tears. You should be looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... A School Festival... And a play, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? Are you interested, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course I'd like to see a show if my friends are in it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd even like to see the whole process from the beginning, rehearsals and even the actual show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, you can! And having you there will be good for us since you can offer us pointers and whatnot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, you won't mind?
In that case, I'll gladly come and help!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aww, I'm so jealous!
I want to see your rehearsals too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Didn't you say that couldn't come to the School Festival because you're doing something with your family that day?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... But I really, really want to go...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... Hey, chin up! I'll perform some of the best parts of the play just for you at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You will?! Yaaay!
I can't wait to see it♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing your rehearsals.
A few days later
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, we're in the clear. People are too busy preparing everything right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sorry for inconveniencing you like this, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're not. I owe you more than this for your kind guidance and advice. Besides, I'm curious about Tsukasa's play myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And this is his classroom.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Sweet Juliet! I will free you from the confines of your prison!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It sounds like the rehearsal had already begun.>
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate A
rows.Line: Not so fast! It shall be me who takes Juliet's hand in marriage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Nonsense! I'm the one and only real Romeo!
I refuse to lose Juliet to an impostor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's this?! You're all also Romeo?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <There are quite a lot of Romeos in this play...>

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: They also mentioned a Juliet, so it seems like an adaptation of Romeo and Juliet.

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <Yes. A loose adaptation... Judging from all actors carrying sword props, this version has more action scenes.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate A
rows.Line: Urgh! You got me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate B
rows.Line: How could I have lost?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha! That's two less Romeos to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, all good so far! But I want this battle scene to be more bloody and dramatic!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate C
rows.Line: I have an idea... Let's give each Romeo a different weapon. They all look the same when they all have swords.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's genius! What weapons do you think would work? I want to hear everyone's suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa's classmates were having a great time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes. Tsukasa really has quite a bit of charisma...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Like Miku, he's a natural mood maker.
People simply gravitate towards him.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I've noticed...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Correct me if I'm wrong, but it seems to me that you're not all that interested in events like these?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I spent all middle school events chatting with one lonely friend on the school's rooftop...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it may be different this time...
A lot has changed since then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe if you trained for a hundred... No, a thousand... Better yet, a hundred million!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If only you trained for a hundred million light years more, you may've been a worthy rival. Alas, I shall erase you from existence here and now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Tsukasa, isn't a hundred million light years a measure of distance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Is there a problem? It makes it clear how entirely my rivals are just like fish out of the water!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Uh, just checking if you meant it. Hahaha.

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
If Tsukasa's involved in this event,
I might find it enjoyable too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I seems like Tsukasa has been a positive influence on Rui too.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <He does make everything more fun for everyone.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And if there's anything I, or anyone from SEKAI, can help you with, just ask.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We're all friends after all.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure. Thanks, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You're most welcome, Rui.>
